1.title: Providing World-Class Intelligent Equipment for Top Global Enterprises
1.contentHtml:
TXAM announces the full completion and operation of its two smart manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Huizhou, marking a new phase of scaled development for the company.

Formation of a Dual-Base Layout

With the successful topping-out of TXAM's 60,000㎡ smart manufacturing base in Huizhou, TXAM has established a "dual-core" layout centered on its Shenzhen headquarters and Huizhou for capacity expansion. This structure will provide strong production and delivery guarantees for the company to undertake billion-yuan orders from top global enterprises.

The Huizhou base adopts industry-leading smart production line designs, equipped with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems, achieving full-process autonomous control from part processing to final delivery.

Digital Management Upgrade

While increasing capacity, TXAM continues to advance its digital transformation. By deploying advanced MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and WMS (Warehouse Management System), TXAM has achieved real-time collection, monitoring, and analysis of production data, significantly improving production efficiency and product quality stability.

The company stated that it will continue to increase R&D investment, deepen its focus on non-standard automation, and contribute more to China's smart manufacturing.

2.title: High-Precision Robot Assembly Line Successfully Deployed at a Well-Known Home Appliance Manufacturer
2.contentHtml:
TXAM has successfully completed the installation and commissioning of a customized high-precision robot assembly line for a well-known home appliance manufacturer, which is now officially in production.

Project Background

This home appliance manufacturer operates multiple modern production lines both domestically and internationally, with extremely stringent requirements for the precision and stability of automation equipment. Leveraging 19 years of industry experience and technical expertise, TXAM successfully won the bid and undertook the design and delivery of this major project.

Technical Highlights

The entire line uses TXAM's self-developed UVW vision alignment platform, combined with six-axis industrial robots, achieving assembly precision at the ±0.1mm level. With CAD import one-click changeover functionality, the line can complete product switching within 15 minutes, greatly enhancing production flexibility.

After project delivery, the customer's single-line production cycle time was reduced to 12 seconds per unit, with a yield rate exceeding 99.9%, earning high recognition from the client.

3.title: TXAM Shines at CIBF International Battery Exhibition, "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" Attracts Attention
3.contentHtml:
In May 2025, TXAM showcased its self-developed "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" and other core equipment at the CIBF International Battery Technology Exhibition, marking its full entry into new tracks such as new energy and smart warehousing logistics.

New Energy Track Layout

Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is booming, with a sharp increase in demand for automation equipment. TXAM seized the opportunity by establishing a new energy smart equipment R&D team, focusing on the development and manufacturing of equipment for lithium battery module PACK production lines and smart warehousing logistics systems.

Core Product Showcase

The "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" exhibited this time features an advanced servo drive system and precision guide rail structure, characterized by smooth operation, precise positioning, and high efficiency. It is widely applicable in new energy battery warehousing and logistics scenarios.

During the exhibition, TXAM's booth attracted numerous domestic and international customers for visits and negotiations, resulting in multiple cooperation intentions on-site.

4.title: Milestone: TXAM's Shenzhen & Huizhou Dual Manufacturing Bases Complete 100,000 Square Meters
4.contentHtml:
In March 2026, TXAM's Huizhou Smart Manufacturing Base officially commenced full production, marking the formal establishment of the company's "Shenzhen-Huizhou Dual Base 100,000 Square Meters Smart Manufacturing Base" strategic layout.

Dual-Core Drive, Capacity Leap

The Huizhou base covers 60,000㎡ and adopts industry-leading smart production line designs, equipped with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems. After production begins, the company's overall capacity is expected to more than double, with annual output value potentially reaching hundreds of millions of yuan.

Serving Top Global Clients

Leveraging expanded capacity and 19 years of technical expertise, TXAM is now capable of undertaking billion-yuan orders from top global enterprises. The company will continue to deepen its focus on non-standard automation, providing higher-quality products and services to long-term partners such as TCL, Skyworth, Midea, Konka, and Changhong.

Looking ahead, TXAM will continue to advance smart manufacturing upgrades, contributing more to China's smart manufacturing.

5.title: Successfully Delivered 86" Commercial Display Fully Automated Assembly Line to Mexico
5.contentHtml:
In February 2026, TXAM successfully delivered a customized 86" commercial display fully automated assembly line to a well-known commercial display manufacturer in Mexico, with 5 containers of entire line equipment shipped cross-border.

Project Overview

This production line covers core processes such as automatic dispensing, high-precision lamination, and automatic screw fastening, perfectly solving the challenge of damage-free assembly for ultra-large flexible screens. This marks another major breakthrough for TXAM in the Americas market, following its success in Southeast Asia.

Technical Highlights

The entire line uses TXAM's self-developed high-precision robot dispensing system (±0.2mm), combined with a UVW vision alignment platform, achieving high-precision lamination of large-size panels. Through an intelligent control system, the production line can achieve one-click product switching, compatible with 65~110" multi-size products.

After overseas delivery, the equipment operates stably and has received high praise from the customer, laying a solid foundation for further in-depth cooperation.

6.title: Insight: The "Second Half" of New Energy Power Battery Assembly Technology
6.contentHtml:
With the explosive growth of the new energy vehicle market, power battery assembly technology is facing new development opportunities. This article explores the trends in the "second half" of new energy power battery assembly technology.

Automation Becomes a Necessity

Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is thriving, with a sharp increase in demand for power batteries. Traditional manual assembly methods can no longer meet the needs for large-scale, high-efficiency, and high-quality production, making automated assembly technology an industry necessity.

Deep Integration of Software and Hardware

The core of an unmanned factory lies not in hardware stacking but in data flow connectivity. The efficient integration of WCS (Warehouse Control System) with automated robotic arms is key to achieving intelligent production. Through TCP/IP communication protocols, real-time interconnection of equipment status and digital transparent management of production data are realized.

Leveraging 19 years of deep expertise in the automation field, TXAM has successfully developed a series of equipment for new energy battery module PACK production lines, which have been deployed in several leading companies.
